source.name: FIFA Member Associations
source.statement: FIFA identifies 211 member associations across six confederations.

policy: Names are an association directory only. Do not generate team rosters, player identities, ratings, kits, badges or competition rights from this directory. Each association needs its confederation, team eligibility, squad source, date, and rights review verified before publication.

confederation_mapping.method: Exact intersection of FIFA's 211-member directory with the six confederation member-association directories.
